comment: The triage case set (spec 2026-09-29 criterion 3): what the parser's one call says a line is. Each case: [input, expected kind ('a|b' accepts either), a word the target must contain when the thing is not in scope, else null]. Scope: corpus.json's loft scope; vocabulary: the village's own verbs (engine verbs it offers and its world verbs).
cases: how long have I been here
who am I in this dream
which way can I go from here
how do I get out of this room
what am I supposed to type
what was I in the middle of
give the clockmaker a big hug
run my fingers over the clock case
tell Tace the gear rolled south
ask the clockmaker how the frost began
say that I love this loft
reach for the lamp on the far shelf
open the window by the bench
take the tweezers off the workbench
examine the frost on the glass
unlock the case with the small key
put the gear in the case
comment_held_out: Held out (written 2026-09-29 after the prompt's examples were fixed, never used to tune them): fresh phrasings that show whether the examples taught the categories or the case set. Reported separately as held_out; a drop against the main score is the sign of a prompt fitted to its own cases.
held_out: what hour is it in the village
what have I got on me
where do the paths from here go
how do I talk to people here
I forget what I was doing
put my ear to the clock case
